name: What is involved in residential disability and accessibility remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in residential disability and accessibility remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility modifications adapt a home for aging in place or mobility challenges, focusing on safety, clearance, and comfort. Common upgrades include widening doorways with modified framing, replacing standard tubs with curbless, barrier-free walk-in tile showers, and adding secure backing behind drywall for grab bars. Work can also involve lowering countertops, installing comfort-height vanities, and smoothing out flooring transitions between rooms. These projects combine heavy finish carpentry, plumbing adjustments, and precision tile work to blend functional safety with standard interior aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessibility remodeling involves widening doorways, reinforcing walls for grab bars, building zero-threshold tile showers, and lowering vanities for safer mobility.
